capabilities: Move unfinished checkbox tasks from earlier dated sections to today's section
Preserve completed tasks and unmigrated notes in their original entries
Copy regular Markdown content from migrated task branches to today's section
Create the current month's work log file and heading when missing
Preview the migration and skip structurally invalid date sections
disambiguation: Not a general task manager; it only moves unfinished tasks between monthly YYYYMM.md work log files in a configured directory.
extras: Installation requires building from source with npm; the command name is localized to Chinese when the interface language is Chinese. The README recommends enabling the preview for the first migration and keeping a vault backup.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to carry unfinished tasks forward from previous dated work log files into today's entry.
summary: Task rollover plugin that moves unfinished checkbox tasks from earlier monthly work log entries to today's entry, preserving completed tasks and notes.
